text:
Amy Chen: Heads up — we're missing granular RTB/spot bid curve inputs from VoltCloud and Zenith for the cost model refresh. Need this to finalize Q3 reserved vs ephemeral mix assumptions.
Jordan Patel: Agreed. Can partners provide: SKU, region, historical fill rate (90d), avg spot price, spot floor/ceiling, preempt_prob, reserved_discount, commit_tenor?
Sanjay Rao: + eviction lead time, burst pool availability, and any per-SKU min_commit. Without those the model is just a guess.
Kevin Liu: tagging @VoltCloud & @Zenith (vendor handles) — we asked last week but haven't seen CSV yet. Do they have a standard CSV spec they can drop? :eyes:
Amy Chen: For clarity here's the CSV header we expect — keeps our ingestion simple:
```
sku,region,sku_tier,commit_tenor_days,min_commit_gpu,reserved_ratio,avg_spot_usd,spot_floor_usd,spot_ceiling_usd,preempt_prob_90d,eviction_lead_time_mins,burst_capacity_pct,notes
```
Jordan Patel: Also add column "fill_rate_90d" and "avg_latency_percentile_ms" if they can. We use fill_rate to estimate lost capacity and latency to estimate QoS premium.
Sanjay Rao: If partners won't expose per-instance latency, an envelope by SKU tier is fine (e.g., p95: 120-220ms).
Elena (marketplace-bot): VoltCloud uploaded a file vcloud_bidcurves_q2.csv to the vendor dropbox at https://files.redwood/voltcloud/q2.  (automated)
Kevin Liu: Great — I'll pull and sanity-check. If anything missing I'll ping vendor and copy the list here.
Amy Chen: Quick ask for modeling: can they include an occupancy curve (percent of committed fleet typically used by other tenants) or at least an estimated headroom pct at 95th percentile? That really changes reserved utilization assumptions.
Jordan Patel: Also confirm billing granularity (per-hour vs per-minute) and whether they prorate partial-hour evictions. Those billing quirks change unit cost calc.
Sanjay Rao: One more: historical correlation of spot price spikes with region/regulatory events (e.g., maintenance windows). Even rough labels help flag tail-risk.
Kevin Liu: I'll attempt a first-pass import today and post a short summary table in this thread with any gaps.
Amy Chen: Perfect — target to have consolidated vendor inputs by EOD Wed so finance can run the blended-rate scenarios. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: If VoltCloud/Zenith are slow, we can fallback to using marketplace historical scraper + a conservative +25% eviction delta for initial model. Not ideal but workable.
Amy Chen: OK. Thanks team — Kevin, ping here when you have the summary.
Kevin Liu: Will do.
